Sweet potato treat 😋 
Full Recipe:
1 medium cooked sweet potato (about 1 cup)
½ cup milk 
1-2 tbsp raw honey
2 tbsp unsweetened cocoa powder
Optional: ½ tsp vanilla extract
Optional: pinch of salt

Preparation Steps
Cook the Sweet Potato: Roast, steam, or boil your sweet potato until it is completely soft all the way through (easily pierced with a fork). 

Cool Completely: Allow the cooked sweet potato to cool down entirely. You can even pop it in the fridge. 
Tip: Using a warm sweet potato will melt the ice cream texture and make it runny.  

Measure: Scoop out 1 cup of the soft, cooled sweet potato flesh (discard the skin). 

Blending & Freezing InstructionsLoad the Blender: 
Add the cooled sweet potato, ½ cup milk, 1–2 tbsp raw honey, 2 tbsp unsweetened cocoa powder, and your optional vanilla extract or pinch of salt into a blender.  

Blend Until Smooth: 
Process on high speed until the mixture is completely uniform, glossy, and creamy with absolutely no remaining potato chunks.

Freeze to Set: 
Pour the smooth mixture into a glass jar or a freezer-safe container. Cover it tightly and place it in the freezer for 1.5 to 2 hours. 

Scoop and Serve: Remove from the freezer once it hits a thick, scoopable soft-serve consistency. 

 Note: If you leave it in the freezer overnight, it will freeze solid. If that happens, simply let it sit out on the counter for 10–15 minutes to thaw slightly before scooping.
